com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.parsers

类 SAXParser

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.parsers.XMLParser
      • com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.parsers.AbstractXMLDocumentParser
        • com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.parsers.AbstractSAXParser

  • 所有已实现的接口:

    直接已知子类:
    SAXParserImpl.JAXPSAXParser

    public class SAXParser
extends AbstractSAXParser
    This is the main Xerces SAX parser class. It uses the abstract SAX parser with a document scanner, a dtd scanner, and a validator, as well as a grammar pool.
    版本:
    $Id: SAXParser.java,v 1.7 2010-11-01 04:40:09 joehw Exp $
    作者:
    Arnaud Le Hors, IBM, Andy Clark, IBM
